summary: Adds an independent, compact, single-window Human Review Lab with canonical dataset assembly, blind review, durable SQLite annotations, in-GUI analysis, export, backup, and native validation.
compatibility: The Product GUI, backend processing pipeline, canonical media artifacts, and existing databases are unchanged. Human Review uses its own production/test SQLite files and is launched through a new CLI command.
risks: Some canonical evidence items intentionally have no directly resolvable local media and require Skip or Relink Media in the GUI.

Interactive SQLite writes use WAL/NORMAL for responsiveness; a sudden operating-system or power failure can lose the most recent uncheckpointed transactions, while app close, manual backup, and each 50-revision backup force a FULL checkpoint.
Qt offscreen screenshot capture validates geometry and scaling but cannot substitute for a human review of native font rasterization and media decoding.
